title: ADMIN HUB OP FEATURES
features:
🟣 ADMIN HUB V2 - GOD MODE EDITION 🟣

The ultimate, most overpowered Client-Side Admin Hub for Roblox! We combined Combat, Troll, Visuals, and Movement features into a sleek, modern UI (Rayfield Amethyst). Works on almost ALL games! 🚀

🌍 PREMIUM FEATURES:
🇺🇸🇧🇷🇪🇸 Real-time 3-Language Support (English, Portuguese, Spanish).
🔒 Standalone Anti-Bypass System (No crashes on your executor!).

🦸‍♂️ MOVEMENT & PLAYER:
🛸 Fly & Vehicle Fly: Fly your character or levitate any car you drive.
🧗‍♂️ Wall Climb: Scale giant walls like Spider-Man.
🌊 Jesus Mode: Walk smoothly over water, lava, and acid without sinking.
🧲 Item Magnet: Pull all dropped tools from the map directly to your feet.
🛡️ Anti-AFK & Auto-Rejoin: Never get kicked for idling and auto-reconnect if dropped.
🛡️ Anti-Fling: Turn ghost mode! Nobody can collide with or push you around.
📝 Chat Logger: Spy and read enemy team chats secretly.

⚔️ TROLL & COMBAT (GOD MODE):
🔫 Silent Aim & Triggerbot: Magic aimbot and auto-fire for perfect FPS dominance.
💥 Kill Aura: Melt anyone who gets close to you (requires an equipped weapon).
👻 Invisibilidade / God Mode: Create an invisible clone, become immortal, and hit enemies without taking damage.
🌪️ Fling ALL & Fling Player: The ultimate tornado! Yeet the entire server out of the map.
🎯 Hitbox Expander: Enlarge enemies' hitboxes on your screen so you never miss a shot.
🛸 AirWalk (Magic Carpet): Spawn an invisible floor beneath you and walk through the sky.
⚠️ Fake System Message: Scare the server by sending fake "Shutdown" yellow chat messages.
🖱️ Alt+Click Delete & Btools: Delete any annoying wall, part, or locked door with one click.

👁️ VISUALS & SERVER (X-RAY & ESP):
🧱 X-Ray: Make all walls in the map semi-transparent (glass style).
🪩 Rave Mode: Turn the server's sky and lighting into a crazy flashing disco.
👁️ Advanced ESP: Advanced Nametags showing enemy Health (HP) and Distance through walls.
🥔 Potato Mode (FPS Boost): Delete all game textures and run at MAX FPS on weak PCs!
☁️ No Fog / Anti-Blind: Remove annoying fog and flashbangs from your screen.
☀️ Time Control & FOV: Change the game time (0h-24h) and adjust your Field of View.
🌍 Server Hopper: Escape admins by instantly hopping to an empty server.

👑 EXTRA COMMANDS:
♾️ Load Infinite Yield: Built-in injector for the greatest admin command script!
🥶 Freeze & Skin Stealer: Freeze enemies locally or steal their entire Avatar/Outfit.
📍 Waypoints: Save custom locations and teleport back to them whenever you want.
